Ā. (लोठते) 
__1 To roll on the ground. 
__2 To go, move. 
__3 To resist, oppose. --

P. (लुठति) 
__1 To roll about, roll on the ground, wallow, welter, move to and fro; मणिर्लुठति पादेषु काचः शिरसि धार्यते [[
]]; गृहे गृहे पश्य तबाङ्गवर्णा मुग्धे सुबर्णाबलयो लुठन्ति [[

.]] 
__2 To agitate, move, stir. 
__3 To touch; पृषदपरुषविषाणाग्रेण लुठति [[
[लुठ्-ल्युट्] Rolling, wallowing, moving to and fro.

p. p. Rolled down, rolling or wallowing on the ground. 
-तम् The rolling on the ground (of a horse).
